lines.text: Now put the two ideas together.
Everything on your plate carries months of a farmer's
work and a long journey behind it. Food left uneaten
on the plate throws all of that away —
the labour, the fuel, the months.
The remedy is not complicated and needs no
equipment. Take what you will eat. Go back for
more if you are still hungry. Finish what you have taken.
How would buying food grown near your town reduce its food miles?
Trace the chain in Fig. 3.10 and mark which stages would get shorter.
Eat well. Share. Respect what is on your plate.
Buy from those who grow it.
